privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This notice explains what information this website collects and how it is used.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: When you send an inquiry or a request for quotation, we receive the details you enter: your name, company, email address, phone number, role, the product and project details you provide, and your message. We also record the page the form was sent from and the language you used.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body: We use this information only to answer your inquiry, prepare quotations and follow up on your project. We do not sell it or share it for marketing.

sections.heading: Where it is stored
sections.body: Form submissions are stored with our cloud provider, Amazon Web Services, and are accessible only to authorised Al Bayan staff.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: The website sets one functional cookie that remembers your language. It does not use advertising or analytics cookies.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: You can ask us to correct or delete the information you have sent by contacting us through the details on the contact page.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using this website you agree to these terms.

sections.heading: Information on this website
sections.body: Product descriptions, specifications and images are provided for general information. Binding specifications, prices and delivery terms are those stated in a written quotation or contract.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.body: Text, images, designs and trademarks on this website belong to Al Bayan Electronics & LED Technologies Factory or are used with permission. Do not reproduce them without written consent.

sections.heading: Links
sections.body: Links to other websites are provided for convenience. We are not responsible for their content.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: We take care to keep this website accurate and available, but we do not guarantee that it is free of errors or interruptions.

sections.heading: Governing law
